title: Is this worth your money? ✈️ New MSFS2020 marketplace airport review!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just added a highly varied trio of airport destinations, taking us from corporate flight lines in the US over to unique international hubs in East Asia. Whether you're managing a fleet of business jets or looking to expand your commercial route network, this week's drop has an environment tailored to your operations.

In this marketplace breakdown, we are looking at everything from the highly anticipated overhaul of Teterboro Version 2 to the regional charm of Kentucky and a vibrant gateway in Northeast China with Yanji Chaoyangchuan. Let's break those down to see which of these scenery updates deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

To make sense of this drop, we have organized the latest releases into two logical categories:

✈️ NORTH AMERICAN EXECUTIVE & REGIONAL HUBS: We kick off with the business jet capital of the East Coast: Owensboro Daviess County Regional Airport (KOWB) by MSFSceneryBuilders. This public airport features custom vehicles and ground layouts, though some details feel exceptionally clean. Then, we jump into the premier general aviation gateway to New York City: Teterboro Airport (KTEB) V2 by Dreamflight Studios. Fully recreated from the ground up, this package brings 7 highly detailed FBOs with fully modeled interiors, realistic apron wear and tear, and custom static business jet traffic.

🌏 EXOTIC ASIAN GATEWAYS: Next, we head over to China to check out Yanji Chaoyangchuan Airport (ZYYJ) by Catch Star. While the terminal architecture is unique, a lack of official developer screenshots makes this one a bit of a gamble. We dive into the limited previews to tell you if it's worth the investment.

Are you upgrading your corporate flight routes with Teterboro V2, or are you exploring new destinations in East Asia? Let me know in the comments below which scenery is landing in your simulator first!

If this marketplace breakdown helps you save money and find the best add-ons, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism updates!
